description: embedding/requests.json: how a service asks its embedding provider for the vectors of many texts.

providers.description: How each kind of provider is asked, by its `type` (EmbeddingConfig): every kind, and no other.

textsPerRequest.description: How many texts one request carries, at most: a batch is cut into slices of this many, each one request, in the order of the texts.

atOnce.description: How many requests are made of the provider at once, however many resources are being indexed.

requestSeconds.description: How long each request has, counted from when it is sent and not from when its batch began. Asking a busy provider again is within it.

busy.description: A request for the vectors of documents that the provider answers busy is asked again, after each wait in turn, while the request's own time allows the wait. A provider busy at every asking fails the request with that status. A query is asked once.

statuses.description: The statuses by which a provider says it is busy.

againAfterSeconds.description: The wait before each asking again, in order.

startAgain.description: How many times, at most, a starting service asks again a provider that answered 404, taken to be still fetching the model, or could not be reached, taken to be still starting: within the time the service has to start.
